protocol.reason: Apple protocol evidence and provider reporting are different instruments.

population.reason: Both populations are attributed conversions but the provider claim can use modeled coverage.

sequence.reason: The provider report does not expose the Apple postback sequence.

conversionType.reason: The provider install definition is not identical to an Apple winning conversion.

attributionWindow.reason: The windows overlap but are not equal.

timeAxis.reason: Postback time and provider report time are different clocks.

timezone.reason: Both sides are normalized to UTC.

finality.reason: Both inputs must be settled before a verdict.

notes: Example contract only. It permits a directional comparison and never upgrades a provider claim to Apple truth.
